environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running the gRPC TokenValidationService in a pod exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type ClusterIP. An internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) forwards TCP traffic on port 50051 directly to the pod without any L7 inspection. The pod's service account has no network policies restricting ingress. Any pod or VPC-peered service can reach port 50051 and issue arbitrary gRPC calls with manipulated ciphertext, observing distinct error_code responses (2001 vs 2002) to mount a padding oracle attack.

config.ingress: AWS NLB, TCP passthrough on port 50051
